prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production sprite atlas for a side-view lane defense game. Handmade Japanese picture book game art, tactile cut paper with wool felt and crayon textures, adorable small monsters, warm cream and earthy teal, muted coral, soft morning light, high-quality cohesive diorama illustration. No text, no letters, no UI, no watermark. Create ONE exact 4-column by 3-row sprite atlas on genuinely TRANSPARENT background, all 12 cells equal size, evenly aligned centers, generous 12% empty transparent padding around EACH character, no grid lines. Each cell contains exactly one full-body isolated character, all facing RIGHT in three-quarter side view, standing pose. Row 1 from left: cheerful blue water slime; cream mushroom knight with red spotted cap, wooden shield and short sword; little white ghost with lavender flame; chubby sleepy sage-green dragon with gold horns. Row 2: woolly cream ram with a sprout; mossy stone golem with flower; tiny orange fox carrying a maple leaf; lavender star wizard with pointed hat and wand. Row 3: dark plum fuzzy shadow ball with yellow eyes; purple bat with yellow eyes and spread wings; tiny charcoal hooded wizard with purple flame; large dark mushroom king with coral cap and little crown. Entire bodies and weapons fit in each cell. All characters fully disconnected. Uniform orthographic scale by cell. Keep background genuinely transparent, no scenery, no floor or shadow below figures. Square image.
